hero.badge: Available on Android · iOS coming soon
hero.description: FitMesh Sync reads steps, heart rate, sleep and calories from your Galaxy Watch or Wear OS and surfaces them on a personal web dashboard. No opaque clouds, no ad trackers, no social logins.
hero.pricing: One-time purchase €3.49 · or €0.99 every 6 months · secure payment via Google Play

features.heading: Everything your smartwatch records, organized and visualized.

items.title: Steps & distance
items.desc: Auto-sync with Health Connect and Samsung Health. Runs in the background, even with your phone locked.

items.title: Heart rate & VO₂ max
items.desc: Daily average, min/max range, resting heart rate. Spot trends in your cardiovascular health over time.

items.title: Sleep with stages
items.desc: Total duration, deep, REM, light, awake. Color-coded bar and instant quality badge.

items.title: Calories & activity
items.desc: Active and basal calories, route, elevation, floors climbed. Walks in green, workouts in red.

items.title: Your own dashboard
items.desc: Your data lives on the server you pick — not on a third-party cloud. Access from any browser, no social account required.

items.title: Built for caregivers
items.desc: Advanced mode coming soon: family group with morning sync alerts when an elderly relative goes silent.

privacy_block.heading: Your health data is not a product.
privacy_block.description: FitMesh Sync never sells, shares or profiles. Your data stays on the server you choose — your home NAS, your VPS, or our shared endpoint. You decide in the app settings.

final_cta.heading: Ready to start?
final_cta.description: Download the app, grant Health Connect permissions, and in 30 seconds your data is live.

footer.tagline: Sync your smartwatch data to a premium dashboard of your own. Privacy-first. No opaque clouds, no ad trackers.

cookie_banner.title: Cookies & privacy
cookie_banner.description: We use strictly necessary cookies for the site to function and, with your consent, Google Analytics to learn how to improve the product. No advertising or profiling cookies.
